tasks.subject: Task 1: Project scaffold
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A running Next.js app with the design system's tokens in place and a placeholder page.

**Files:**
- Create: package.json, tsconfig.json, next.config.ts, postcss.config.mjs, eslint.config.mjs, .gitignore, .env.local.example
- Create: app/layout.tsx, app/globals.css, app/page.tsx

**Verify:** `npm install && npm run build` → build succeeds

```json:metadata
{"files": ["package.json", "tsconfig.json", "next.config.ts", "postcss.config.mjs", "eslint.config.mjs", ".gitignore", ".env.local.example", "app/layout.tsx", "app/globals.css", "app/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm install && npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["npm install completes with no errors", "npm run dev serves placeholder heading", "npm run build completes with no errors"]}
```

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/cache.ts", "lib/getClientIp.ts", "lib/rateLimit.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["checkRateLimit throws RateLimitError on 4th daily call", "works without Upstash env vars", "type-checks cleanly"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Agent 1 — Ad Intelligence API route
tasks.description:
**Goal:** POST /api/agents/ads scrapes competitor's Meta Ad Library page, returns 3-5 bullet insights or found:false. Checks daily rate limit (pipeline entry point).

**Files:**
- Create: app/api/agents/ads/route.ts

**Verify:** curl POST with real brand → found:true with bullets; curl with gibberish brand → found:false; 4 curls in a row → 4th returns 429

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/api/agents/ads/route.ts"], "verifyCommand": "curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/agents/ads -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"competitorBrand\":\"Nike\"}'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["400 on missing competitorBrand", "429 on 4th daily call", "found:true with insights for real brand", "found:false without fabrication when no data"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 11: PipelineRunner orchestration + wire into page
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Sequentially call all 4 agent routes updating card state; per-agent retry without restarting pipeline; rate-limit message distinct from per-agent error. Replace placeholder app/page.tsx.

**Files:**
- Create: components/PipelineRunner.tsx
- Modify: app/page.tsx

**Verify:** Manual browser test — happy path (real brand, all 4 cards complete), empty-data path (obscure brand), rate-limit path (4th run in a day blocked)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["components/PipelineRunner.tsx", "app/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev — manual browser verification per plan Task 11 Steps 3-4", "acceptanceCriteria": ["sequential execution with correct card states", "429 shows page-level message not per-card error", "per-agent retry reuses upstream results", "form disabled while running"]}
```
